metadata.description: Phase 5 (Community): visual mode editor, mode registry with signing and a verified badge, carrier PCB, translations, build guides, community processes. Refreshed 2026-10-22 after phases 2-4 software (decisions P5R-1 to P5R-14); plan phases 1 (the visual mode editor) and 2 (the editor and the simulator: field.lua shown in the web view, POST /api/reload, the editor's Test button, decisions P5B-1 to P5B-7) built in software; plan phase 13 (missing modes sent to boxes from the GM console, the maintainer's P5R-8; P5B-8 to P5B-17) planned. Plan phases 3 (the editor's geo, GM command, role and kind blocks, screens; P5C-1 to P5C-7), 4 (signed mode packages: canonical ustar archive, Ed25519 manifest, tools/mode_package.py, registry index schema, shared vectors; P5C-8 to P5C-13), 5 (the sandbox-escape battery, which closed two watchdog escapes; P5C-14 to P5C-16) and 6 (signed packages in the controller and console; P5C-17 to P5C-21) built in software; P5B-9 answered by the maintainer (firmware-built mode keys only). Plan phase 13a (missing modes from the GM console: the controller, console and protocol side; join keys 16 and 17, the endpoints boxes fetch from, the start guard, the invite dialog's Send missing modes; P5D-1 to P5D-12) built in software 2026-10-22; 13b (the box fetching, checking and keeping signed mode packages: mode_package.c, mode_fetch.c, mode_store.c, mode_fetch_esp.c, join keys 16 and 17 in core/src/join.c, node.modes_failed; P5E-1 to P5E-14) built in software against 13a's contract. Plan phase 7 (scenario blocks in the GM console: a Blocks view of the Scenarios tab's YAML editor writing the same manifest, read back through the controller's check, Blockly 13.3.0 vendored with a hash-only CSP exception for its two stylesheets, every scenario example compiling identically; P5F-1 to P5F-12) built in software 2026-10-22. Plan phases 8 (the registry repository's template registry/template/ with its CI, tools/registry_check.py, a sample submission tested with throwaway keys; P5G-1 to P5G-11) and 9 (CONTRIBUTING.md 'Submitting a community mode', docs/community/, the draft RFC for the package format; P5G-12 to P5G-14) built in software 2026-10-22; AC-6 met in this repository's template, AC-11 met. Plan phase 10 (German in site, console, editor, app and box texts; tools/i18n_check.py; docs/translations/; P5H-1 to P5H-11) built in software, AI-drafted, review pending. The leftover of plan phases 3-6, the mode editor making the package itself (Make the package: the canonical unsigned archive made in the page by editor/package.js, byte for byte tools/mode_package.py pack's, proved against the Python packer for the vectors, every built-in mode and the examples; the manifest a mode key will sign and the exact sign and verify commands; signing stays offline; P5I-1 to P5I-6), built in software 2026-10-22. Plan phase 11 (Traditional Chinese as written in Taiwan, zh-tw, in site, console, editor, app and box texts; the box's fonts carry exactly the 153 letters of its Chinese texts from Noto Sans TC, now compressed, image 0x1bf220, 13% free; tools/gen_box_fonts.py --check; P5K-1 to P5K-12) built in software 2026-10-22, AI-drafted, review pending. Plan phase 12 (build guides for the Satellite, the I/O pod and the target addon as text in hardware/<node>/BUILD.md, rendered on the project page's build page in pt, en and de, pins checked by tools/check_wiring.py; P5J-1 to P5J-14) built 2026-10-22; AC-10 met in text, photos are HW2.
metadata.next_plan_phase: none in software: the reviews of German and Traditional Chinese; the contract cases for the mode-package endpoints; 13 on real boxes in HW3; the build guides' first builds and photos in HW2
